name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Warm Fluffy Donuts (Skip Raspberry Seed Dip)
brandOrRestaurant: Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)

prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy 1–2 warm donut holes plain or dipped lightly in the chocolate sauce, and skip the raspberry dipping sauce if it contains berry seeds.
watchOuts: Fried pastry dough and sugar—share with the table in remission
